title: Choir and Well
author: Ulyana Eriksen
blurb: Yara Blackwood, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
